how: We read the website of every San Diego wedding florist listed on Lazo (213 listings, 159 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: same-day delivery shops, a national online bouquet company, a stationery studio, a venue and a city rose garden that landed in this category. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Do you design for the venue, or deliver arrangements? Installation and teardown are the difference in price.
What is grown locally in North County for my month, and what gets shipped in?
Can I see a full wedding's florals, not a bouquet photo, at a budget like mine?

picks.name: Chic Flowers
picks.blurb: Chic Flowers is a luxury wedding florist in San Diego and Los Angeles whose artistry is rooted in European garden design, from bouquets and centerpieces to large installations. The site walks through what a full-service wedding includes.

picks.name: SISTI & CO. | Wedding Planner & Florist
picks.blurb: A floral designer and wedding planner in one: Kimberly Sisti's studio combines a fine art aesthetic with the couple's vision, and history is her design inspiration. SISTI & CO. is based in San Diego and works across Southern California.

picks.name: Jennifer Cole Florals
picks.blurb: Jennifer Cole Florals promises a personalized, luxurious floral experience and will guide you whether you arrive with a defined aesthetic or a few ideas. The Carlsbad studio's site features work at 5M Ranch, the Fairmont San Francisco and the Hotel del Coronado.

picks.name: Camellia Wedding Flowers/ San Diego Corporate Florist
picks.blurb: Atalanta started Flowers by Atalanta in 2003 with a $500 investment from her mom and a tiny bucket shop in La Jolla; it is now Camellia Wedding Flowers. She has worked with flowers since she was 15, and every full-service wedding is custom-designed and priced to its scope.

picks.name: Organic Elements
picks.blurb: Sharon, creative director of Organic Elements, began thirty years ago when a Beverly Hills floral shop took a chance on an eighteen-year-old, then freelanced across Los Angeles before settling in San Diego. Custom floral art for luxury weddings.

picks.name: Moments in Bloom
picks.blurb: Dede Barnes and Tara McClurkin, both born and raised in San Diego, started working together in 1997 at Dede's family flower shop and went into floral design as partners. Moments in Bloom in Carlsbad is a partner florist for Wedgewood's La Jolla Cove Rooftop, Carlsbad Windmill and Headquarters venues.

picks.name: Studio Fleurish
picks.blurb: Studio Fleurish treats a wedding as a living masterpiece, viewing each celebration through a fine art lens and using flowers to translate emotion into a space. Bespoke floral services for Southern California and beyond, from a Carlsbad studio.

picks.name: Jupiter West Coast Floral
picks.blurb: Jupiter West Coast Floral does weddings, small parties and weekly flowers for businesses, run by a designer who was picking neighbors' flowers into bouquets at age three. The site publishes estimates as a starting point for your floral budget, with final pricing set by flower choice, season and scope.

picks.name: Inecui Flowers & Gifts
picks.blurb: Inecui is a floral collective built on fair, sustainable and community-focused practices, collaborating with local cultivators and following the cycles of the earth. Its wedding page covers romantic, festive and intimate moods, and cempasuchil season is a favorite.

picks.name: The Floral Craft
picks.blurb: Danielle runs The Floral Craft, a retail studio in La Mesa conjuring lush, modern flowers for weddings and events in deep contrasting tones and opulent colors. Everyday bouquets too, for couples who want their florist to have a shop.

picks.name: Finest City Florist
picks.blurb: Finest City Florist in Lakeside has created pretty things for San Diego since 2008 and specializes in weddings and events. Locally owned, with designs built from fresh farm-sourced flowers and hand-delivered rather than shipped.

picks.name: Adelaide's
picks.blurb: The traditional option: Adelaide's has been La Jolla's florist since 1936 and calls itself a full-service floral and event company that will design your wedding from the ground up if you cannot picture it yet. Call and ask for a designer to start.
